top_drivers: U.S. 10-year Treasury yield remains elevated near 5.277%, preserving dollar carry/rate support.
USDJPY repeatedly rebounded from intraday lows and remained near the upper half of today's 157.44-158.17 range in the latest verified quote.
Broad-dollar demand from European fiscal/political stress supported USD during the day.
counterevidence: September U.S. payroll growth was weak and October Fed-hike expectations fell sharply.
Takaichi's fiscal-discipline message reduced one Japan-side yen-negative risk channel.
Oil retraced from the morning spike, reducing terms-of-trade pressure on JPY.
Japanese intervention risk remains an asymmetric cap if USDJPY accelerates upward.
scheduled_catalysts_known_pre_cutoff: 22:45 JST S&P Global U.S. services/composite PMI final.
23:00 JST ISM Services PMI; secondary consensus around 55.

scenario_map.base: Range-to-slight-up: USDJPY ends 08:00 modestly above its 22:00 midpoint, supported by high U.S. yields, but without a clean breakout.
scenario_map.upside: Strong services/price data lift Treasury yields and push USDJPY above 158.17.
scenario_map.downside: Weak services/employment data reinforce Fed-pause pricing, lower yields, and send USDJPY below 157.44.
